address: GF, North Esplanade, Wynn Palace, Avenida da Nave Desportiva, Cotai, Macau
bio: Mizumi features three zones devoted respectively to tempura, teppanyaki and sushi, each with two set menus. Those seated in the main dining room adorned by a koi centerpiece can order anything from the à la carte menu. Chef Hironori Maeda ensures that everything is crafted with utmost care. Try the juicy, tender Kagoshima Wagyu tenderloin deftly grilled on a teppan, with sea salt, wasabi, black pepper, and onion gravy on the side....
